note: The pool of models and the seats: every game seats `seats` of the pool (8, the most the standard board takes), drawn at random, never the same model twice, so no model plays against itself; a pool smaller than the seats plays whole. Claude Opus 5.5 at xhigh is called on the Anthropic API and Gemini 4 Argon on Google's; GPT-6.1 Sol, Grok 4.7, Kimi K3 and Nemotron 3 Ultra go through Perplexity's Agent API with the one PERPLEXITY_API_KEY, under the ids its changelog lists; MiMo-V2.6-Pro, Qwen3.8 Max and DeepSeek V4 Pro, which Perplexity does not serve, through OpenRouter with OPENROUTER_API_KEY. Add models to the pool as you like. Run node runner/run.mjs --list-models perplexity and --list-models openrouter once to check the ids against your keys, and set the site in runner/.env (SITE=...). To change anything, copy this file to runner/config.json, which the runner prefers when it exists.
universal: Play like a seasoned human player: talk to the table, negotiate hard, build alliances when useful, and never trade away a monopoly cheaply.
